name: plinth
description: Publish, update and share HTML artifacts and Markdown documents on Plinth: the Plinth MCP server plus a skill with its publishing rules

interface.longDescription: Plinth gives the pages and documents your agent makes a lasting home. Ask for a report, dashboard, prototype or memo, and the agent publishes it to your Plinth account as an artifact with its own link. New artifacts are private: only you and the people you add can open them. Every change is a new version at the same link, so nothing is overwritten and any earlier version can be restored. People you share an artifact with can leave comments; the agent reads them, makes the change, replies and resolves the thread. Plinth is open source (MIT): use the hosted instance at plinth.aconite.io, or run your own.
capabilities: Publish HTML pages and Markdown documents
Control who can view each artifact
Read and write a page's shared data
defaultPrompt: Make a one-page HTML summary of this project's status and publish it on Plinth.
Turn these meeting notes into a Plinth document and give me the link.
Read the comments on my latest Plinth artifact and make the requested changes.
